question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I (Material):
A. Diamagnetic
B. Ferromagnetic
C. Paramagnetic
D. Non-magnetic

List-II (Susceptibility ($\chi$)):
I. $\chi = 0$
II. $0 > \chi \geq -1$
III. $\chi >> 1$
IV. $0 < \chi < \varepsilon$ (a small positive number)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
solution:
Diamagnetic: small negative susceptibility, $-1 \leq \chi < 0$ (II).

Ferromagnetic: very large positive susceptibility, $\chi >> 1$ (III).

Paramagnetic: small positive susceptibility (IV).

Non-magnetic: $\chi = 0$ (I).

A-II, B-III, C-IV, D-I.
